recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-31703; any further UX redesign of the navbar emphasis should be handled as a new work-group/design decision rather than as a correction to this published issue.
issue_request: FHIR-31703 was a Published FHIR-core/R4B ballot issue reporting that the Resource Types navbar item appeared highlighted no matter which page or tab was selected. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept Resource Types intentionally emphasized but asked for a treatment that looked less like a selected tab.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git caafe82c5220821d282ae8b295e4b7a472875296, which changed tools/templates/newnavbar.html and replaced the yellow Resource Types span with bold/italic text while applying broader navbar changes for FHIR-16526 and FHIR-12773. Follow-up commit 94db6fa8858589cf796c599e9fc1919fa8f6137c restored missing <%level%> link prefixes without reverting the Resource Types emphasis.
additional_context: tools/templates/newnavbar.html is an active template included by many source pages and template wrappers through [%file newnavbar%]. FHIR-I WGM Confluence minutes for May 2021 reference FHIR-31703 and record the 21-0-0 Not Persuasive with Modification motion. Later navbar history did not restore the yellow styling or add selected-tab behavior, and an exact Zulip issue-key search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because tools/templates/newnavbar.html:38 already renders Resource Types as Resource Types, and searches found no remaining Resource Types styling in current source/templates.
